## Status — November 10, 2026

The current plan is FPGA position PI with MCU ADC/DMA and gap estimation. There is no recorded levitation demonstration or measured stability, position accuracy, thermal performance, or shutdown latency for this design.

## SPI Bring-up — November 7

The project chat reported a received MCU value of **165**, which equals **0xA5**. This supports reception of the expected byte in the standalone FPGA-to-MCU test. The proposed second pattern, `0x3B` (59), was a follow-up check; success has not been recorded.

The [standalone guide](simple_byte/README.md) records HDL simulation across all 256 bytes, MISO release on deselection, partial-byte restart, synthesis/routing using 8 logic cells, and Cortex-M4 compilation in Watch-only mode. These are recorded checks, not rerun measurements. They do not establish MOSI command reception, ADC sampling, DMA execution, the full application link, or levitation.

## Earlier Application Verification — October 26

The [verification record](docs/verification.qmd) covers MCU position control and FPGA current PI. It supersedes the site's former October 15 figures, but it does not validate the later FPGA-position design.

| Check | Recorded result and scope |
|---|---|
| Firmware behavior | Passed host checks for packets, scheduling, bounds, faults, and web handling |
| MCU source compilation | Eight C translation units; full executable link and programming unverified |
| HDL tests | Shared-bus integration and current-PI arithmetic simulations passed |
| Calibration | Five algorithm tests passed; no measured calibration dataset |
| Enabled FPGA build | 1099/5280 logic cells; 2/8 DSP blocks; 46.59 MHz routed estimate |
| Disabled FPGA build | 644/5280 logic cells; 0/8 DSP blocks; 52.99 MHz routed estimate |

The required clock was 24 MHz. Tool timing is an estimate. The enabled build used nonzero test gains; shipped commissioning defaults remained disabled.

## Calculations and Measurements

The proposal's air-core sizing example cannot support 10 g at 20 mm center distance from a 12 V, 8 ohm coil. Its illustrative 10 mm position-PI model is unstable under the assumed inductance and damping. Neither calculation characterizes the selected electromagnet. See [System Design](design.qmd#stability-calculation).

| Demonstration test | Evidence still needed |
|---|---|
| Five 20-to-10 mm round trips without contact | Video, ruler reference, moving mass, and actual gaps |
| ±5 mm endpoint position band | Independent position readings alongside the estimate |
| Requested/estimated gap graph, current, and faults | Hardware webpage demonstration and display latency |
| PI constants changed from webpage | Accepted gains, application boundary, and resulting response |
| Position resolution | Local voltage slope, noise, repeatability, and holdout errors |
| Timing and independent shutdown | Scope/logic-analyzer captures under web traffic |
| Continuous operation | Temperature/current logs through thermal equilibrium |

There are no levitation photos, measured traces, or demonstration videos included yet. The [measurement log](data/results/measurements.csv) is blank. See the [checkoff record](docs/checkoff.qmd).
